headline: OmniRoute Slashes AI Token Costs by 95% with Open-Source Gateway
summary: OmniRoute reduces token costs for AI coding agents by up to 95%. It connects local tools to 250+ AI providers.
details: AI coding agents boost developer productivity but consume many tokens, leading to high API subscription fees. OmniRoute is an open-source AI gateway that tackles this problem by combining token compression with smart routing.

OmniRoute acts as a local proxy or containerized gateway, managing API keys, balancing traffic, compressing prompts, and routing requests to the cheapest or most reliable provider. It supports 90+ permanently free tiers and links to over 250 API endpoints.
The standout feature of OmniRoute is its custom token compression, saving between 15% and 95% of token usage per request. This dramatically lowers API costs for developers working on large codebases.

OmniRoute can be deployed on a local machine using Docker or run as a Desktop app/PWA. It natively supports MCP and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, making it highly compatible with advanced coding agents.
